subject: Full-loop: evaluator round-robin, contingency & debrief cadence
body:
From: TalentCloud <talentcloud@agency.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate intro + availability (Alex Morgan)

Hi Karthik + Laura,

Quick intro: Alex Morgan (ex-Scale infra PM) is excited about the Senior Infra PM role. They'd like a virtual full-loop (4x30m slots) next week. Attached: resume and a proposed availability grid. Can you confirm whether Redwood can run a round-robin evaluator sequence (to avoid double-booking senior ICs) and a 2-hour post-loop debrief window?

Attachments: Alex_Morgan_Resume.pdf

Thanks,
Marta
TalentCloud (on behalf of Alex)

-----
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate intro + availability (Alex Morgan)

Thanks Marta — and Laura/Marissa/Jonas, can we run this as a 4-slot virtual onsite next Wednesday (May 12)? Proposed tile: 30m System Design -> 30m Product -> 30m Cross-functional -> 30m Hiring Manager + Exec touch.

Key asks:
- Round-robin primary for System Design (rotate between Jonas/Marissa so neither takes two heavy design loops this week).
- 15m buffer between slots for notes/short breaks; 30m post-loop debrief block (2:00–2:30pm PT) where we consolidate and complete the scorecard.
- Backup interviewer for each slot in case someone drops <24h out.

I attached a quick panel-tiles file (fullloop-panel-tiles.xlsx) with suggested invitations. Laura — can you confirm HM + Exec availability? Marissa — would you take primary on System Design at 10:00am PT if Jonas is overloaded? Jonas — can you take product at 10:30am PT?

If that works I'll coordinate calendar invites and a candidate scheduling link.

Karthik
Director, Hiring Ops
Redwood Inference

-----
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re: Candidate intro + availability (Alex Morgan)

Karthik — HM (Sana) confirmed exec slot at 11:00am PT. I can shift to the product slot (10:30am) if Jonas prefers design. Proposed timeline:

10:00–10:30 System Design (primary: Marissa; backup: Jonas)
10:30–11:00 Product (primary: Laura; backup: Marissa)
11:00–11:30 Cross-functional (Sana — Hiring Manager + Exec)
11:30–12:00 Hiring manager + culture (wrap + candidate Q&A)
12:00–12:30 Debrief (all interviewers) — I pushed debrief earlier to avoid afternoon conflicts.

Contingency: if someone cancels within 24h, swap in backup and move debrief to 1:00pm PT to give a 30m padding window for notes. I'll update the panel-tiles doc with names.

Laura
Sr. PM, Product Teams

-----
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Full-loop: evaluator round-robin, contingency & debrief cadence

All good from my side — happy to take System Design primary at 10:00am. A couple operational notes:

- Please include the debrief-scorecard-template.docx in the invite so interviewers can pre-fill quick notes between slots.
- Suggest we assign a scribe (rotating) for each loop to capture 1–2 bullets per candidate; if nobody volunteers, Jonas, can you flag someone on the cross-functional panel?
- Candidate tech check (10 min) 15m before 10:00am to verify audio/screen share. I'll own the check-in.

Marissa
Staffing Partner (interim)

-----
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@gmail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: TalentCloud <talentcloud@agency.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 17:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Full-loop: evaluator round-robin, contingency & debrief cadence

Thanks — Wednesday, May 12 works. 10:00am PT start is perfect. A couple quick logistics/questions:

- I prefer 4x30m with short breaks — appreciated.
- Will the hiring manager share a short product brief ahead of time? If so, happy to scan it beforehand.
- My timezone note: PST -> currently on a short travel but will be on laptop.

Looking forward to it — please send calendar invites with the candidate tech-check link.

Best,
Alex Morgan
alex.morgan@gmail.com

[Attachments: Alex_Morgan_Resume.pdf]

-----
Notes / next steps:
- Karthik to send invites + include debrief-scorecard-template.docx and tech-check link.
- Laura to finalize HM/Exec slot and add product brief to the shared doc.
- Marissa to cover candidate tech check and mark scribe for system design.
- Backup list in spreadsheet and calendar alerts set for 24h cancellation window.

End of thread.
